main_body: A flat sand-coloured ground patch (4x3 tiles) with sparse speckle and a small grey pebble and a pink flower; it is terrain, not a standing object.
top_band: none - a uniform sand ground texture, no top/front structure
evidence: The column scan shows only a base sand tone (#e2c584) with scattered lighter (#f1dca2) and darker (#c9a666) speckle pixels, which is ground texture rather than a top band over a front face. As a terrain ground patch the 3/4 standing-object contract does not apply, and it has no side faces or vertical elevation. Nothing is drawn wrongly.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 11 distinct colours and a median of 3 per tile, against 26 for the grass reference and 7 for the paving reference. The sand uses three tones (base, light speckle, dark speckle) with sparse single-pixel dots, and 10% of its pixels sit in 5x5 flat blocks while both references have 0%. It has no clumped grain, no pebble shading and no tonal variation across the patch. Beside the grass it looks thin and flat. The small grey pebble and pink flower are isolated accents that do not add material depth.
